g.text: babes - babes u there? lmao i need a hand with something i got a plan n i need a decoy
this is gonna be soooo good
so i was just on patrol w/ lettie n eleanor n we just snagged a scaldra truck
fiiine i'll go get aoi, she'll help
i knew u n i were a thing 4 a reason
thing was filled with like 50,000 boxes of packing peanuts
u know, the biodegradable ones? basically cheese poofs without the cheese flavour
no clue what the fk they needed them 4
at 1st we were gonna just dump them in the river, or w/e but then i had a thought...
'naaaaah fam, i got a fkin use for theeeeese'
so. tomorrow. i need u 2 distract amir when he's at his computer, yeah?
don't care how. just keep him talking. n i'm gonna completely fill his room with fkin' packing peanuts
this is gonna be so good lmao
What if Lettie's rats get into them?
yeah that's the point lol. don't worry i'll help him clean it all up
biodegradable. n i checked with her first, she's fine with it. says they're basically rat snacks anyway
psh. its all in good fun. but fine, suit urself. i'll get aoi 2 help
now that's what i'm talking about!
